info.title: Fabric IQ Ontology Data Agent (Auto FNOL Triage)
info.description: Public-endpoint wrapper around the existing Fabric ontology / GraphQL data-agent endpoint already used by the Copilot Studio 'InvokeAutoFNOLOntologyAgent' action. No VNet/Private Endpoint required - replace the server URL below with your tenant's actual Fabric data-agent public endpoint (see ../../Auto_FNOL_solution/fabric/configure_data_agent_ontology.py for how that endpoint is provisioned).

post.summary: Query the AutoFNOL_Ontology graph (Policyholder, Vehicle, Adjuster, RepairShop, Policy, Claim, FraudSignal, SubrogationFlag) with a natural-language question.

question.description: Natural-language question, e.g. 'Show coverage limits for Policy POL-00005'.

200.description: Structured answer grounded in the ontology graph.
